3412.title: File failure diagnostics are lost before rendering
3412.rootCauseOneLine: The file-change assembler drops Pi resultText, and the UI renders an empty-diff message before supplied stderr.
3412.proposedFix: Preserve failure diagnostics through assembly and projection, then prefer errors for failed rows without diffs.
3412.caveats: Two clean synthetic/component runs; no live Pi session. Complete fix spans multiple subsystems.
